installer.help.tesseract:
Text in images

Downloads Tesseract so srxy can read text inside photos, scans, and images embedded in PDFs or Office files.

This does not need a GPU. Files are kept in your install folder — no system-wide Tesseract install is required.
installer.help.ffmpeg:
Audio/video helper

Downloads ffmpeg so srxy can open sound and video files.

This is only the media tool. Spoken-words search also needs Smarter search (the speech AI) and a GPU in the GUI. Files stay in your install folder.
installer.help.semantic:
Smarter search (needs a GPU)

Installs the AI libraries from PyPI (PyTorch, sentence-transformers, faster-whisper, and related packages — including NVIDIA pieces when CUDA is used; see the privacy notice).

Unlocks:

  • Similar meaning (related text, not just exact spelling)
  • Visual description (what a picture looks like)
  • Spoken words (what was said in audio/video — also turn on Audio/video helper for ffmpeg)

Needs a GPU that PyTorch can use (NVIDIA CUDA on Linux/Windows; Apple Silicon MPS on macOS).
installer.help.models:
Download AI models now

Fetches the AI model files from Hugging Face during install (similar meaning, visual description, and speech).

You can skip this; srxy can later install the models when needed. Prefetching needs Smarter search.
installer.help.path:
Run from Terminal

Adds a short block to your shell startup file so you can type `srxy` in a new terminal window (same app as the application menu).

Open a new terminal after install for the change to take effect. Uninstall removes this shortcut.
installer.help.no_gpu:
No usable GPU detected

Smarter search (similar meaning, visual description, and spoken words in the GUI) needs a GPU that PyTorch can use.

On this Linux installer we look for an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA). None was found, so those options stay off. You can still install srxy and use:

  • File names and folder search
  • Document text, tags, and metadata
  • Text in images (if you download Tesseract)

If you add a compatible GPU later, open this installer again and turn on Smarter search.
privacy.title: srxy desktop installer — privacy & third-party notice
privacy.intro_mit: srxy itself is MIT-licensed. This installer is an optional desktop distribution channel; you can still install srxy from PyPI and use the GUI, TUI, CLI, or library without this installer.
privacy.intro_downloads: This AppImage does not embed NVIDIA/CUDA binaries, Hugging Face model weights, Tesseract, or ffmpeg. When you opt in, the installer downloads components from third parties. Please review their sites and privacy policies before continuing.
privacy.what_heading: What this installer may download (only after you choose the related options)
privacy.optional_ai: Optional AI search extras from PyPI
privacy.optional_models: Optional AI models via {party} — default model cards
privacy.bullet_local: srxy searches files on your machine. It does not upload your files to a remote srxy search service.
privacy.bullet_third_party: Choosing downloads contacts third-party servers listed above. Those parties have their own privacy policies (linked above).
privacy.bullet_cache: Cached models, OCR results, and embeddings stay under your install prefix (SRXY_HOME) or ~/.cache/srxy for non-prefix installs.
privacy.ack_footer: By checking the acknowledgment box you confirm you understand these third-party downloads and accept responsibility for complying with their licenses and privacy policies.
